name: analytics
description: MoxyWolf analytics plugin — read-only reporting across data sources, one command per source. Currently ships the google-analytics command (GA4 Data API via a service account) with generic traffic reports plus Lens-Test campaign reports (acquisition by channel, first-touch signup source, custom-dimension segment, and a markdown scoreboard with week-over-week). Built to grow: future commands can add Microsoft Clarity, Ahrefs, PostHog, and others. Credentials always come from the environment, never hardcoded.
